evidence_basis: Severe TBI, separate 24 h and five-day IV alanyl-glutamine groups (six each) with background enteral nutrition. Results section reports cerebral dialysate glutamine before/during/after short infusion 529/549/532 micromolar (unchanged). Long group: Figure 4 caption and Results describe significant glutamine increase after infusion only; cerebral glutamate fell during and after (Figure 6 caption/Results). Abstract conflates timing/values. Methods selected for catheter placement avoiding frontal contusions. Figure captions read, plots not inspected. No calibration to terminal substrate concentration.
